title: AIMS Cancer Outcomes Study
official: Advanced Integrative Oncology Treatment for Adult and Pediatric Patients With Cancer: A Prospective Outcomes Study
summary: The overall aim is to describe disease-free survival (DFS) in early stage cancer patients and three-year overall survival (OS) outcomes in advanced stage cancer patients receiving Advanced Integrative Oncology (AIO) treatment in a prospective consecutive case series outcomes study. We will collect data and study outcomes for patients with cancer who receive care at AIMS Institute.
